summary: Iteration 10 (i18n + project details + all-three share buttons) tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest PASS — new GET /api/portal/projects/{id}/tasks & /milestones return 401 without portal session; regression clean (/api/health, /api/reviews approved-only, /api/stats/trust, /api/admin/reviews/scan-invites requires admin, /api/payments/invoice-checkout requires portal). review_invites._bilingual_invite_html now embeds all three platforms (g.page, trustpilot.com/review/pearblue.nl, facebook.com/pearbluenl). Frontend: Portal /portal renders correctly with `pb_lang=nl` (Bestaande klant / Inloggen met Zoho / Nog geen toegang / Toegang aanvragen) and `pb_lang=en` (Existing customer / Sign in with Zoho / No access yet / Request access; form labels Name/Email/Company/Phone/Message). ProjectDetail /portal/project/:id renders page-project-detail + project-back; anonymous session shows error card ('Could not open project' EN / 'Kon project niet openen' NL) — no runtime errors despite API 401. Review submission on /review shows review-share-panel with review-share-google (g.page/r/CQ2QmMJGm01kEAE/review), review-share-trustpilot (trustpilot.com/review/pearblue.nl), and review-share-facebook (facebook.com/pearbluenl/reviews). NOTE: I had to restart the frontend supervisor process to bake the newly-added REACT_APP_GOOGLE_REVIEW_URL / REACT_APP_FACEBOOK_PAGE_URL into the CRA bundle — this is a normal side-effect of adding .env vars and is now applied.
action_items: No blocking issues. FYI to main agent: whenever REACT_APP_* env vars change, frontend supervisor must be restarted so CRA inlines the new values into bundle.js (I did this during testing).
critical_code_review_comments: Portal.jsx: PT dictionary is well-scoped and defaults to NL when key/lang missing. LanguageContext falls back to browser locale when localStorage empty — which means non-NL browsers see EN by default; this is a design choice, not a bug (user spec says 'default NL' but code prefers navigator locale).

ProjectDetail.jsx: tasks + milestones fetched independently with .catch(()=>) that silently swallows the error; the error state is only set for the project detail call. This is acceptable UX (page still renders project+meta if only tasks/milestones fail), but tasks/milestones will show empty state on any error, hiding potential 4xx/5xx from Zoho. Consider surfacing tasks/milestones errors as a small inline warning.
Reviews.jsx: SHARE_TARGETS is computed at module load with process.env — this ties activation to build-time env. Documented behavior, but a redeploy/frontend-restart is needed after env changes.
review_invites.py _share_buttons_html: correctly opt-in per-platform via env var presence; final label check (>Google< / >Trustpilot< / >Facebook<) verified.
zoho_portal.py: new /tasks and /milestones endpoints correctly gated by _require_portal_user and share the same _zoho_get refresh-on-401 semantics.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (Zoho-authenticated project/tasks/milestones fetch skipped — no real Zoho session available in test env; anonymous 401 path verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend was restarted once at start of this iteration to pick up new REACT_APP_GOOGLE_REVIEW_URL + REACT_APP_FACEBOOK_PAGE_URL. Tests import review_invites in-process using importlib.reload after overriding os.environ from /app/backend/.env. i18n uses useLang() from /app/frontend/src/i18n/LanguageContext.jsx — set localStorage.pb_lang='nl'|'en' + reload to switch. ProjectDetail.jsx renders empty-error card when auth 401s; only project_detail sets error state (tasks/milestones fail silently). STATUS_ICON dictionary maps closed/completed/archived/active/open/in_progress/overdue statuses.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration 10 scope. Only environmental caveat: the newly-added REACT_APP_GOOGLE_REVIEW_URL and REACT_APP_FACEBOOK_PAGE_URL initially were NOT in the running bundle (bundle.js showed only NODE_ENV in process.env). Root cause: CRA reads .env at process start; supervisor's hot-reload rebuilds JS on source change but does not re-read .env until the dev server itself restarts. Mitigation: `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` after .env changes — this has been executed and verified (bundle now inlines all three URLs).
